statement: Create new content in paint curves with "Add New Paint Curve Point"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.

Create new content in paint curves with "Add Curve Point and Slide"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.
Use "Place Cursor" in paint curves; the document ends in the state Blender 5.3 produces for the same input and one undo step restores the previous state.

Remove or clear content in paint curves with "Remove Paint Curve Point"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.

Create new content in paint curves with "Draw Curve"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.

Create new content in paint curves with "Add New Paint Curve"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.

Change what is selected in paint curves with "Select Paint Curve Point"; the new selection is what the next edit command acts on, no data is modified, and one undo step restores the previous selection.

Reposition or reshape the current selection in paint curves with "Slide Paint Curve Point"; the resulting positions or shapes match Blender 5.3 for the same input, only the selected items change, and one undo step restores them.
